shared_elements: repeated short stroke or comb-like rows
justification: The only real overlap is very generic: both surfaces use schematic linear marks, some repeated short strokes, and small circular/dot-like forms. A is dominated by multiple boat-like figures with rows of crew/marks arranged across a flat field, whereas B is a single frontal anthropomorphic figure or stele with facial/body features and curved bands, so the depicted content and organization are fundamentally different.
